user_operational_acceptance.source: User reported all operations were fine after the E5/E6 delivery
user_operational_acceptance.scope: Aggregate acceptance of delivered operations, no device-specific numeric certification
user_operational_acceptance.E6: operations accepted; quantitative/device release evidence still pending
user_operational_acceptance.new_followup_pending: Single-destination link objects skip the intermediary panel; clearer/larger scene text

previous_acceptance.source: User explicitly clarified E3-E4 all passed and authorized E5-E6; do not repeat those checks. No per-device numeric performance inferred.

storage_contract.owner: Nuxt, browser-local localStorage per signed-in account
storage_contract.write_policy: At most one queued write per second, plus exact checkpoints before leave/pagehide/hidden and Classic navigation
position_priority: valid saved pose for requested room
safe current object approach for invalid saved pose
storage_contract.migration: No earlier world-position schema exists. Unsupported schema or account mismatch recovers to a fresh safe save; package revision changes revalidate each restored position using current collision.
storage_contract.storage_failure: Keep current visit in memory with notice; Classic remains available

source_typecheck.meaning: Compilation only; not UI or device acceptance

manual_acceptance.check: Refresh/relogin/Classic return retain room, position, facing and team; another account stays separate
Nine-room travel, C/R portal arrivals and Safe reset; storage failure/invalid-save recovery if user can exercise them
Desktop/narrow, available real devices, keyboard/touch/gamepad and reduced motion; record unavailable device/input types explicitly
User records 20 seconds while walking, exports JSON, repeats room/Classic transitions and observes idle/hidden behavior
Canvas switch preserves pose; runtime errors offer Retry/Static/Classic; no duplicate instance or stuck input after return

limitations: No assistant browser/visual/input/collision testing, screenshot, alternate login, fixture or extra frontend server
User recording explicitly labels development versus production and includes raw bounded samples
Local load-to-first-state is not LCP; performance.memory is not retained heap or GPU memory
Owned created/destroyRequested/destroyed counters do not certify all browser listeners, timers or GPU resources
Unavailable devices/APIs must remain unavailable rather than pass
E3-E4 user acceptance does not certify E5-E6; F4 real roster NPC art/random appearances remain planned
